snapshots.bound: At most3 successfully captured snapshots in one live source attempt, stages drawn in strict order postspawn,postinitialization,terminal, without repetition. Skipped stages require an original failed/unknown prefix; no successful continuation after a skipped mandatory normal stage. One publication attempt per stage; a failed/unknown snapshot write latches failure and prevents every later snapshot publication (no retry of uncertain bytes).
snapshots.capacity: Reserve all bounded encoding/capture/record/link work from original arm allocation before each operation. Three finite slots are not a resource extension: if original whole/file/metadata/time capacity cannot accommodate them, refuse before spawn or retain original failure; feasibility remains an open qualification.
snapshots.forward_refs: identity_observation/group_observation refer only to earlier actual server ProcessObservations whose attempt is base_attempt. first_error, when published, is an earlier captured diagnostic; raw first always stays on live owner. No observation references a future snapshot.
snapshots.identity: ordinal0 has previous_snapshot=null; ordinal n>0 pins the exact immediately previous complete same-base snapshot with ordinal n-1. Immutable fields repeated exactly from base are condition,pair_id,nonce,worker_attempt,worker_launch_ack,request,preparation,workspace,profile,initialization_deadline_ns,generation_deadline_ns,shutdown_deadline_ns. schema and source-observed spawn_state/cost_prefix deliberately differ; base spawn_state remains not_attempted forever. Neither the base nor a predecessor points forward. Publication never overwrites a path or prior body.
snapshots.path: Fixed worker/backend_attempt_snapshot_0.json, _1.json, _2.json, index derived only from prior completed capture count; no caller-supplied path. A failed publication is retained as an unknown attempted path and is never reused.
snapshots.postinitialization: state=initialized, same original server identity and process observations, after complete SourceInitializationProof/BackendInitializationObservation capture and before any H admission; raw errors absent. It does not contain those later child Pins and cannot prove their success without separate captures.
snapshots.postspawn: state=spawned, spawn_state=acknowledged, actual identity and both completed ProcessObservation Pins required; exact source-owned original process/group equality. Captured before normal initialization.
snapshots.terminal: At most once after planned close or failure cleanup prefix, before optional BackendClosure publication. state=closed only with actual successful planned close; otherwise failed/unknown with missing observation Pins/null identities when not obtained. Earlier first error remains, even if eventual exit0. Complete closure still requires its own full original typed evidence.
snapshots.wire: BackendAttempt-v2 adds base_attempt, previous_snapshot, snapshot_ordinal and snapshot_stage to all original fields; V1 is not accepted.

spawn_order: Completed original H worker attempt -> worker ProcessObservation -> WorkerLaunchAck -> fixed W authenticates ack.
W original private BackendAttemptHandle -> complete BackendAttemptBase capture -> mark source spawn slot attempted before the one child spawn.
Retain actual returned Popen/raw PID/ownership or original raw error/ambiguous effect before diagnostics.
Actual server ProcessObservation(s) pin only the stable base, actual condition/server/parent/group and original same worker identity; incomplete observations have no success Pin.

Publish postspawn BackendAttempt-v2 snapshot only after the complete corresponding observation captures. Null observations mean genuinely unavailable, never successful identity. A failed/unknown spawn may instead go directly to the terminal failure snapshot/cleanup; no respawn.

Successful initialization may begin only after exact acknowledged postspawn snapshot, actual private handle and required process/group observations. Subsequent children all pin the stable base, never the snapshot they help produce.
attempt_identity_v3.stable_identity: Exactly one actual BackendAttemptBase-v1 is captured per fixed worker/server attempt before server spawn. It contains only earlier request/preparation/workspace/profile/H worker attempt+ack and original J/G/R/cost-prefix facts. No process identity, observation, initialization, admission, exchange, snapshot or closure Pin is in that base.
attempt_identity_v3.worker_observation_order: H independently owns W before backend creation. publish_development_launch_ack_v1 captures an earlier original DevelopmentAttempt prefix from the same actual H handle, with group_observation null and known_records containing no future ProcessObservation/WorkerLaunchAck. It may carry only raw actually obtained PID/start facts. NativeIdentityObserver then produces worker-subject ProcessObservation against that exact earlier capture. WorkerLaunchAck pins that original attempt and the later completed group observation. No later H snapshot is substituted for the earlier identity, no original H clock/cost changes, and missing completed capture/observation remains refusal; private H source must implement this exact order.

completion_projection: For one in-flight request ordinal, require attempt/condition/nonce/admission/request identity and raw.finished<=G; index0/id_slot0/stop=true/model selected alias/generation_settings/n_predict exact request. Counters bounded by selected context/response ceilings and nonnegative. stop_type=none or truncated=true refuses as unexpected/incomplete context; eos/word/limit are represented explicitly. Source documented small n_predict overrun is retained rather than falsely clamped; physical caps remain independent. Empty content may be passed if eos/word; limit with empty content terminates failure without retry. Every token counter must also be <= checked(selected context_tokens + request maximum_generated_tokens); counters outside this finite envelope refuse as source/schema inconsistency. This bound does not claim an exact observed overrun allowance or replace physical accounting.
parsing: Health/slots/complete success require raw.state complete,status200, exact endpoint, source commit/attempt/condition/nonce/ordinal and body grammar. JSON wire Slot has no schema tag: source-owned projection adds SlotBody.schema only after validating exact four raw keys. Completion wire body similarly gets CompletionBody.schema only after exact thirteen-field check. Extra/missing/nested variants reject; raw Error/plaintext responses retained only through RejectedResponse and never sent to agent. The sole separate loading variant is complete health503 with exact literal loading_health JSON; its producer does not latch raw error. All RejectedResponse variants create and retain the actual source-owned refusal/error, and are terminal.
probe_order: Probe ordinals are contiguous across initialization requests. A fully framed complete GET /health status503 with exactly loading_health body creates ParsedLoadingHealth, not a failure and not readiness. It consumes original request/byte/time capacity, and may advance once to the next predeclared health probe strictly before J while within maximum_initialization_probes. No other 503, endpoint/error shape, transport or parser failure can retry. Successful ParsedHealth status200 precedes the exact fresh slots task response. Every response is charged, no reset/refund. ParsedLoadingHealth is never accepted by initialization success, H admission or fixed agent; it is stored only in private initialization history. Empty task fields remain absent. Missing native/source proof refuses.

Workspace closure closes all original writers/descendants; it does not delete the readable source tree or release H read custody. Keep the original readonly/read-custody anchor or a separately qualified actual original-parent reopen capability through both-arm captures, inventories, receipts, seals and assembly. No path reconstruction, new root, renewed worker write authority or inherited-asset access is permitted. Removal/release occurs only in original H terminal cleanup after the full capture/assembly route no longer needs it, under the same E and original budgets.
rules.job_roster: Manifest jobs equal PublicTaskInterface.jobs in complete original order, exactly one per candidate job ID. No sampled/success-only/subset/reordered/new jobs. Missing/mismatched E refuses before dependent capture/promotion; retain raw failure on the already registered original owner.
original_H_clock.earlier_operand: The exact same original H owner retained evidence deadline E: PairCompletionHandle.pair.owner.parent.original_deadline in the selected source snapshot. It is established before preparation and launch; it is not derived from a later completion or fresh clock.
original_H_clock.failure_and_cost: A clock/identity/consumer mismatch preserves first raw error, all earlier attempted reservations/effects, partial captures, unknown dimensions and once-only independent cleanup on the same original H. No recapture, replacement attempt, fresh deadline, refund or worker continuation. Cost/time snapshots remain prepublication; later actual publication/cleanup stays on H/outside observation.
original_H_clock.intervals: Original S,J,G,R,L,common_cutoff and original run deadline keep their full existing derivations and obligations. Natural worker/server stopping and original worker publications must finish within their respective R/G/J constraints. H DevelopmentCompletion.closed_ns and later capture/receipt/seal/assembly observations may exceed R only after actual complete stopping/closure and while <= the unchanged E. Every actual owner.check keeps its original stricter operational predicate; this field relation does not relax it.
original_H_clock.phase_order: Earlier preparation/launch need only the already-retained original H E and their original prerequisites, never a future pair completion or seal. Later successful pair closure and ProgrammeCapture occur only after actual full original paired closure. No new blanket completion/seal prerequisite is inserted into earlier phases.
original_H_clock.producer: DevelopmentOwner.finish_pair_backend_v1 assigns original_cutoff_ns = that exact retained E when publishing the already-required DevelopmentPairClosure-v3 after both actual completed original arms. No additional publication, deadline or owner is created.
required_equalities: each earlier original arm launch.body.evidence_deadline_ns == original_H.original_deadline

original_H_cost_observation.capacity: This is the already-required cost_observation publication, under original metadata/request/write/readback/retention/cost reserves. Count every actual occurrence/repeated reader; unknown full cumulative cost remains unknown. No new budget or synthetic cost reconciliation.
original_H_cost_observation.consumer: PairCompletionHandle.require_original and later complete target admission require the exact same-owner aggregate occurrence/capture and original source/clock ancestry. Decode the existing closed CostPrefix body, not a new cost schema or nominally similar record. Metadata equality alone is insufficient.
original_H_cost_observation.occurrence: The actual original attempt.cost_observation is the completed same-owner CapturedRecord(kind=CostPrefix) from that defined pre-Completion occurrence. Its Pin is assigned exactly to DevelopmentCompletion.cost_observation. If both arms capture separate occurrences, each is an observation of the same aggregate owner at its own original position, not an independent arm charge; neither prefix is added to the other. No sharing is inferred without an actual same captured occurrence/owner proof.
original_H_cost_observation.prefix_time: This prefix includes known earlier actual H/A/B effects, including prior completed raw stream/manifest and workspace evidence. It never claims the future cost of its own serialization/write/readback/close or the later Completion/pair/capture/assembly. Those later actual costs and failures stay on the same H/outside observations, not invented zeroes.
original_H_cost_observation.producer: Same original H owner captures its actual aggregate H+A+B CostPrefix occurrence after the earlier successful original lifecycle/workspace/stream evidence and before the corresponding DevelopmentCompletion publication. Use the existing source-owned aggregate producer, never an arm-local counter or a sum of already cumulative prefix records.
original_H_cost_observation.success: All original CostPrefix fields and unknown/unfinished semantics remain unchanged. Preserve truthful failed/unknown prefixes on the original owner. Actual unknown_dimensions/unavailable measured dimensions or original error state cannot qualify DevelopmentCompletion completeness; no filtering or resetting before capture. unfinished_span records the still-active original H accounting span and its actual original active origins; it is not by itself an unknown measurement or permission to stop/end/renew H early. Do not force it false before later Completion/capture work and do not claim a final whole-host total from this live prefix.

original_H_stream_capture.close_chronology: Each side has an actual successful positive-size EOF observation and once-only pipe-close return. Set the original owned slot to closed immediately after that successful return, before reading the following original-H close timestamp. If the clock read fails, retain closed state and that raw failure; no complete HStreamSideV1 exists and do not retry close or replace closed_ns with zero. A failed/ambiguous close retains original unknown/attempted ownership and also cannot produce a complete side.
original_H_stream_capture.failure_and_caps: Unknown byte counts, missing EOF, forced/unknown close, raw failure or incomplete captured body remains existing original failure evidence, never a successful manifest with zero/empty substitutes. Preserve original stream transfer caps and their original combined/per-side meaning exactly. All raw files/readbacks/manifest, retained raw buffers, fd/clock/cleanup and repeated readers must fit the same predeclared original H/arm shares and file limits; no extra allowance, live-pipe reread, recapture or source expansion.
original_H_stream_capture.private_inverse: Within the existing finish_pair_backend_v1 lifecycle, only the actual same-owner CapturedRecord(kind=HStreamCaptureV1) over both original closed slots fills attempt.complete_stream_capture. DevelopmentCompletion.complete_stream_capture is exactly that capture.pin. PairCompletionHandle.require_original and programme/output admission verify the original attempt, condition, owner_binding, two exact earlier raw captures, full typed side positions and timestamps. No equal dictionary/Pin grants authority.
original_H_stream_capture.publication_order: After both actual stream sides have known complete raw prefixes/EOF and known close timestamps, publish/read back exact stdout raw bytes first, then stderr raw bytes; only then publish/read back HStreamCaptureV1. Its observed_ns is the actual original H observation after both raw captures and before manifest publication, within E. It has no future DevelopmentCompletion or own publication Pin/cost. Every publication attempt is retained before the effect; failed stderr or manifest publication retains the completed stdout prefix and forbids success/retry.
original_H_stream_capture.side_inverse: stdout.name=stdout and stderr.name=stderr, exactly one of each. Each HStreamSideV1.raw_bytes Pin is the actual completed same-H raw capture; side.bytes and side.sha256 equal that Pin and the exact observed raw bytes. Preserve bytes exactly, including zero-length streams; no Unicode decoding, newline normalization, invented padding or omission.
original_H_stream_capture.source_owner: Same actual original H DevelopmentAttemptHandle and original owned stdout/stderr pipe slots, original observation/EOF/once-only-close custody and retained raw bytes. A backend server StreamClosureObservation or parsed stream manifest cannot substitute for the H worker streams.

rules.projection: ProgrammeJob.argv is the exact typed-argument projection to captured-source destinations, original tool binding and original inherited view destinations; source arguments relocate once into immutable H capture namespace. Pin paths follow the fixed capture root relative path convention used by the later selected reader; later materialization preserves this mapping. A future runtime invocation must supply that exact relocation/view mapping, not reuse original mutable workspace names. jobs.report_producer is the corresponding captured file Pin. ProgrammeSeal.source_closure is every captured new source Pin in exact roster order; inherited plan domains remain separately named by existing policy/views, not fabricated source captures.
rules.receipt: ProgrammeCaptureReceipt is H-produced after actual captured manifest readback. captured_files is exactly the complete captured file Pins in roster order. Its cost_before_receipt and finished_ns describe the observed prefix before this receipt publication, never its future close or own cost. Actual enclosing completion/cost remains on the original owner and later known-records/final closure. Failed receipt publication yields no successful receipt/seal; no substitute synthetic failure Pin.
rules.report_source: For every original candidate job, report_source_ordinal indexes an actual captured source file and argv[report_argument_ordinal] is exactly ProgrammeSourceArgument of that ordinal. That producer is the actual job source, never common dispatcher metadata or Backend AgentCompletion. The ordinary source/ABI qualifier still determines that this source implements the original report ABI; declaration alone cannot assert scientific correctness. Repeated jobs may use the same captured source if their exact original jobs/argv remain distinct and complete.
rules.request_join: Manifest condition equals actual arm. public_interface and public_ABI equal the same earlier DevelopmentRequest, original three completed EarlyConstruction products and original pair plan; compare original canonical bodies/job order, not hash strings alone. ABI Pin equals original fully admitted AgentPolicy.programme_capture_ABI. Pair policy/environment/contract owner are identical private objects, with exact original captures.
rules.seal: ProgrammeSeal-v3 fields are projected from actual original policy/environment/exposure/development and captured manifest/receipt. Same pair closure across arms, each exact completion, full jobs/source_closure and original sealed_ns after both capture receipts. No BackendAgentCompletion, decoded record or qualified-root flag substitutes for actual pair/capture. Separate native qualification remains required.

single_capture_entry.exact_migration: The retained capture_pair_v2 spelling is solely a source-owned compatibility forwarder to the same fixed capture_pair_v3 implementation. It forwards the identical actual private arguments exactly once and returns the identical result or propagates the identical first raw error. It does not validate a weaker schema, create a second attempt, catch-and-fallback, recapture, change clocks/caps, or accept older seals. Direct new callers name capture_pair_v3. All retained callers must reach this single implementation.
single_capture_entry.failure: An absent/mismatched wrapper/implementation/caller/source closure is unavailable before capture effects, not permission to call a legacy route.
single_capture_entry.source_identity: Both wrapper and implementation must be members of the same exact earlier admitted source closure and source-qualified fixed binding. The new helper programme_links_v3 must be in the fixed PAPER-FIND-050 SourceSession extension closure with its exact Pin; no ambient import fallback or new original API count.

rules.source_dependency_scope: All newly emitted code/configuration/text dependencies used by a programme must be in the declared roster; all inherited dependencies must be exact earlier allowed view/tool/artifact plan members. The selected native source-isolation/import qualification must enforce this complete closure. UTF8 or a suffix cannot prove absence of undeclared imports/authentic material; missing qualification remains explicit. No new dependency acquisition or primary/data/model opening is authorized.
rules.source_roster: The manifest lists every newly produced programme source file exactly once in ascending unsigned UTF8 bytes of relative_path, never a locale or JSON object key order. Relative paths are canonical POSIX components, no absolute/dot/dotdot/empty/backslash/control/NUL/surrogate, max4096 UTF8 bytes, path depth<=min(64,ConstructionPlan.maximum_depth). The fixed manifest path itself is excluded from sources. Declared bytes/hash/mode must match actual anchored ordinary file; mode contains only permission bits0..0777, no setid/sticky/special mode; actual root owner/uid remains qualified.
rules.static_source_identity: ABI.source_capture, assembler_source and every dispatcher_source are exact ordinary code members of the same full admitted source closure. The actual fixed source callable must match the selected role and byte pin; a caller body or equal-named module is not authority. Source closure/list target amendment remains an independent prerequisite; do not alias it to source_admission.
rules.two_arm_barrier: Both arm source rosters/manifests/receipts must completely validate and finish before the first ProgrammeSeal publication. Registration of one common ProgrammeCaptureHandle precedes any validation/clock/IO and each arm/file/publication slot precedes its effect. Both raw-success arms then publish seals in fixed Condition order. If the second seal fails, the first completed seal is retained evidence but the handle remains failed and no consumer receives pair promotion. No recapture/retry/new budget after any failed/unknown effect.
rules.whole_workspace_partition: A bounded complete metadata inventory of the already-owned arm workspace must partition exactly into: the fixed manifest; declared new source files and their exact ancestor directories; source-owned private lifecycle/control outputs already classified by the original fixed caller; and exact preexisting immutable tool/view/artifact members from the earlier captured preparation inventories/allowed plan domains. Each path has one class; collisions/overwrites/foreign/unlisted paths, symlinks/devices/FIFOs/sockets in the programme-source class refuse. No new body read of inherited model/data/header/key/assets follows from a descriptor. If the original plan does not supply a complete typed permitted-domain/inventory join, capture refuses rather than classifying unknown files as assets.

proof_admission: All producer handles are created before effects and retained on failure. Source/private qualification authorizes producer and channel independently. Closed wire bodies are necessary evidence, never sufficient capabilities. Every child repeats same attempt/condition; receipts additionally exact nonce/source/endpoint/ordinal. Source proof child fields equal the wrapper fields; H host observation initialization matches ack, and source admission equals original selected qualification. The complete mandatory attempt_identity_v3 fixes each attempt Pin subject, snapshot producer order and original H worker exception; generic same-Pin equality is insufficient.

raw_wire.capture: Before each read/write/parser/allocation preadmit maximum transfer and retained expansion under same share and cutoff. Retain exact observed prefix bytes as hex and numeric known lengths. No extra byte/EOF probe at zero allowance. Partial/unknown physical transfer keeps charged reservation; unknown count never treated as0. Complete only when exact declared body length arrives within original cutoff with no first error. Extra bytes from any already observed read refuse; no unbounded read for detection.
raw_wire.decode: Strict UTF8 with no BOM/NUL/surrogate, finite JSON, no duplicate keys, trailing tokens, NaN/Infinity or exponent overflow. Depth/member/token/string limits checked during bounded scan before building tree. No object_hook or permissive library extension. Exact builtin types; bool is not int. Empty/partial/invalid bodies never admitted; a complete valid body whose content string is empty is distinct.
raw_wire.exact_byte_joins: Every hex string has even length, exact lowercase two hex digits per observed byte, len(header_prefix_hex)/2=header_bytes and len(body_prefix_hex)/2=body_bytes. known_wire_bytes is the exact total returned by actual reads, not a count inferred from Content-Length. Complete requires full header framing plus exact declared_content_length=body_bytes and no unknown physical read. BackendHttpRequest wire_bytes=len(wire_hex)/2, body_bytes equals exact encoded body suffix and all limits are admitted before allocation.
raw_wire.framing: Only HTTP/1.1 with one three-digit status and CRLF headers, exactly one decimal Content-Length, no Transfer-Encoding/Content-Encoding/Upgrade/Location, no duplicate header names, obs-fold/control bytes or trailers. Connection closes per request; no pipelining/interim response/redirect/retry. Header names ASCII casefold for duplicate checks, raw original bytes retained. Standard inert unconsumed headers may be retained within fixed grammar but never become metadata authority; any framing-changing unsupported header refuses.
raw_wire.headers: Parsed status/type/framing are derived from raw bytes by fixed parser, not caller fields. Content-Type must be application/json with optional charset=utf-8 only. Other status/types still retain raw prefix and map to RejectedResponse; error bodies need not parse to be safely retained.

limits.maximum_raw_retained_bytes: predeclared profile pending budget includes hex expansion/canonical copies and simultaneous parser allocations

raw_wire.producer: fixed LocalHttpExchange.capture_v2 on actual already admitted socket handle
raw_wire.request_headers: Fixed requests use exactly Host: localhost, Connection: close, Content-Length: <canonical decimal>, and for POST Content-Type: application/json. Source constructs method/path from endpoint enum only; no query or fragment. GET Content-Length=0. JSON POST contains exactly prompt,stream=false,cache_prompt=false,n_predict,seed,temperature,top_p,min_p,top_k,repeat_penalty,response_fields. Sampling values are exact original fixed-point values and literal ordered response_fields; body complete is separately observed at transmission.
raw_wire.units: All observation times integer original monotonic ns, same original source clock and deadline. Source token counts integers are diagnostics, never physical resource accounting. No server timings added to clock budget.

request_identity_chain: For health/slots, BackendHttpRequest.completion_request is null and body_bytes=0. For completion it is the exact CompletionRequest-v2 Pin; BackendExchangeObservation.request and ParsedCompletion.request equal that semantic Pin. RawHttpResponse.request equals the distinct actual BackendHttpRequest Pin. ParsedCompletion.raw selects that exact RawHttpResponse. All attempt/condition/nonce/ordinal/source identities join. No consumer conflates semantic and wire request Pins.

request_v2.selection: Fixed literal in the adapter source selected with CompletionRequest-v2, not arbitrary supplied by participant. Output projection does not change sampling or model task. Exact model alias and n_predict must match selected profile/request.
request_v2.unchanged: exact original prompt/stream=false/cache_prompt=false/fixed n_predict/seed/sampling; no participant override

shutdown_success: All closure children must be present; signal purpose planned_protocol_shutdown/ordinal0/complete/noerror; exit reaped/code0/noerror; streams both known_closed EOF true pending0 unknown false; socket known_closed+observed_absent true; subtree success above; all times within original R. A failure cleanup cannot become complete even with these values; private first error/purpose latches are checked.

source_anchors.fact: Fresh slot serialization has four fields; task fields absent until task/task_prev exists.
Health success exact status ok; readiness is separately middleware controlled.
Slots response comes from selected server task queue.
Completion carries selected request response_fields and actual generation counters.
Native final response exact fields and selected response projection.
Projection output keys are literal requested paths; missing paths omitted.
Documented response_fields request accepts list and flattens slash paths.
Loading state yields503 error; never initialization success.

subtree_success: Server-only success: producer worker,scope server_subtree,root exact server,excluded_live_worker exact still-live worker,enumeration_complete=true,unresolved_count0, every known member exited_reaped, none alive/unknown; no invented empty list. H later independent whole_arm observation requires actual worker natural0 and no exclusions before DevelopmentCompletion.
template_join: CompletionRequest.prompt and prompt_bytes equal RenderedTemplateObservation.prompt and actual UTF8 byte count, with exact computed prompt hash; selected template/renderer and input ABI equal selected artifact/AgentPolicy descriptors. The proof is captured from the actual original renderer return, not a caller hash assertion. Input capture type is the already selected source-owned development_request_ABI, never an untyped replacement.
unknown: Any missing primitive, unavailable child publication, ambiguous clock/identity/read or cleanup keeps live/unknown original custody. Nullable parent pins only when no complete observation publication exists; null never substitutes for closure. Failed/unknown records cannot enter success branch.
